notes: Liliana, Waker of the Dead, printed: '[+1]: Each player discards a card. Each opponent who can't loses 3 life.' Each player discards, so both seats are asked: I discard my only card, and the opponent, who holds exactly one card, discards it. The opponent COULD discard, so it loses no life (20 stays 20): whether a player can't is decided as the discard starts, not by the hand left afterwards. Both hands are empty and both cards are in the graveyards.
